basis: mechanical classification of all 89 suites in supabase/tests (dblink use, DML/DDL presence)

read_only_catalog.execution_class: read-only SQL; safe to run against hosted without writes
read_only_catalog.note: assert catalog/privilege state only (no fixtures, no DML)

disposable_transactional.note: write fixtures (auth.users, profiles, arena rows) inside begin/rollback; nothing commits

committed_concurrency.execution_class: requires a disposable database with independent committed sessions (dblink) and a superuser role
committed_concurrency.note: genuine concurrent RPC contention; must never run against hosted staging

hosted_write_required.note: no suite needs hosted writes; all 89 executed successfully against a disposable database

read_only_hosted_reuse: The security-relevant invariants of 087/088 (H1/H2/H3) and of the storage/extension/ledger contracts are already re-verified read-only on hosted by the verify-complete mode.
The 5 read-only suites could be added to a future authorized hosted read-only run; they currently pass locally.

extension_installation.note: pgtap is not installed on hosted (available only). Installing it requires separate authorization.
